item.title: Code. Break. Secure. My First Step to Self-Hosting
item.description: Code. Break. Secure. Every project starts on localhost. Mine stayed there for a long time — not because of lack of ideas, but because hosting is hard. I wanted my services to be: ⚡ Accessible from anywhere 🌍 ⚡ Secure by design 🔐 ⚡ Cost-effective 💸 ⚡ Something I fully own and control That’s where the real struggle began. ⚠️ The Hosting Dilemma When I decided to move beyond localhost, I explored multiple paths:
